invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.15.0 preserves the locked Parts 1–13 baseline and completes Part 14 Multi-Currency with a workspace Currency Center, active currency registry, dated exchange-rate history, base-currency consolidated KPI reporting, locked invoice/payment rates, per-currency exposure reporting, dual-sided payment allocations, configurable cross-currency settlement, and realized FX gain/loss accounting. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
